sourceRecords.title: UK-Japan offshore wind industrial compact
sourceRecords.sourceText: The UK and Japan signed a cooperation framework covering offshore wind co-investment, floating and deepwater technology testing, supply chains and policy exchange. It includes foundation development, subsea engineering, robotics and digitalisation. Operational responsibility sits with Great British Energy and DESNZ in the UK and METI in Japan.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Open Government Licence v3.0 except identified third-party material; concise factual paraphrase retained.

sourceRecords.title: UK and Japan Sign Offshore Wind Industrial Compact to Deepen Cooperation
sourceRecords.sourceText: Discovery report of the same 10 November compact. Primary government text retained; this report is not an independent event.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: ORLEN Neptun begins Baltic West wind measurement campaign using V-LiDAR
sourceRecords.sourceText: Partrac reports a wind measurement campaign for ORLEN Neptun: two V-LiDAR systems for Baltic West and a third for Baltic East. Site measurements are intended to inform design and financing decisions ahead of Baltic West's planned 2027 auction participation. This concerns floating measurement buoys, not floating turbine foundations.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Partrac Deploys V-LiDAR Systems for ORLEN Neptun Baltic Wind Campaigns
sourceRecords.sourceText: Discovery report of the same Partrac Baltic measurement campaign. Primary company announcement retained; not an independent candidate.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: BW Offshore: 50% owned joint venture awarded NOK 1.94 billion Enova grant for floating offshore wind project
sourceRecords.sourceText: Page is dated 3 November, outside this window. It repeats the conditional Fram grant already covered in the 1 November edition. Recent search indexing does not create a new event.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Vestas - Interim Report Third Quarter 2026
sourceRecords.sourceText: Quarterly corporate results report offshore deliveries and financial performance; no specific floating-wind engineering development identified. Excluded from the weekly engineering candidates.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained. No broader republication rights assumed.

briefingItems.title: UK and Japan sign offshore wind cooperation framework
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: The compact covers investment, technology testing, supply chains and policy exchange.
briefingItems.explanation: Signed on 10 November, the framework includes floating foundations, subsea engineering, robotics and digitalisation.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The announcement sets a cooperation framework; it does not award a construction contract or establish FID.

briefingItems.title: Partrac announces Baltic wind measurement campaign
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: The scope covers two V-LiDAR systems for Baltic West and one for Baltic East.
briefingItems.explanation: Partrac says site measurements will inform design and financing decisions ahead of Baltic West's planned 2027 auction participation.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: This is offshore survey technology using floating buoys; it does not establish a floating-turbine project.

Use source record ID as the final deterministic tie-breaker.
